g.text: NOT FOR FABRICATION OR VEHICLE CONNECTION

g.desc: NOT FOR FABRICATION OR VEHICLE CONNECTION

g.text: Signal-level expansion only. Legacy injector ports have no driver stages. Genuine MS3 USB and SD are retained on the module.

g.desc: Signal-level expansion only. Legacy injector ports have no driver stages. Genuine MS3 USB and SD are retained on the module.

g.text: No extra serial level converter is needed for normal USB tuning on the genuine module.

g.desc: No extra serial level converter is needed for normal USB tuning on the genuine module.

g.text: Do not connect RS232 +/- voltage to SER_RX/SER_TX. These are module-side serial nets.

g.desc: Do not connect RS232 +/- voltage to SER_RX/SER_TX. These are module-side serial nets.

g.text: Stepper outputs may already be power outputs on the genuine card: do not use them as ordinary 5 V GPIO.

g.desc: Stepper outputs may already be power outputs on the genuine card: do not use them as ordinary 5 V GPIO.

g.text: This is a replacement carrier with MS3X-equivalent functions, not a pin-for-pin reproduction of every V3.0 option.

g.desc: This is a replacement carrier with MS3X-equivalent functions, not a pin-for-pin reproduction of every V3.0 option.
